name: Side Panel
author: gshulga
description: A configurable edge side panel that hosts plugin pages and launches standard Omarchy panels.

barWidget.description: An edge side panel for secondary plugins

schema.label: Side panel edge
schema.description: The screen edge from which the side panel opens.

schema.label: Side panel layout
schema.description: Overlay windows or reserve screen space while the side panel is open.

schema.label: Overlay alignment
schema.description: Align a horizontal panel left, center, or right; align a vertical panel top, center, or bottom.

schema.label: Open from screen edge
schema.description: Choose whether to open the Side Panel by double-clicking its edge, hovering at its edge, or not at all.

schema.label: Edge reveal delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer must remain at the configured edge before Side Panel opens.

schema.label: Animate opening
schema.description: Slide the Side Panel in from its configured edge when it opens.

schema.label: Surface mode
schema.description: Framed keeps the opaque card; Glass shows the desktop through the panel. Auto uses Glass only while reserving space for a transparent bar.

schema.label: Dim background
schema.description: Dim the desktop behind the floating Side Panel. Ignored while reserving screen space.

schema.label: Blur background
schema.description: Ask Hyprland to blur the desktop behind the Side Panel while reserving space.
